chain_head_rule: vN+1 by the {path, sha256} PAIR; readers resolve the head by the da_anti_echo_v<N>.json glob and follow the pair. v1 is never edited.

the_allowlist_of_structural_counters.n_arms_agreeing: how many arms agreed -- a count of comparisons this record made
the_allowlist_of_structural_counters.n_arms_declared: how many arms the PARAMS declare -- this seat's own count of a declaration, not a measurement of the day
the_allowlist_of_structural_counters.n_arms_with_a_recomputed_population: how many arms this run recomputed
the_allowlist_of_structural_counters.n_books_verified: how many books a structure declaration covers
the_allowlist_of_structural_counters.n_checks: how many checks a selftest ran
the_allowlist_of_structural_counters.n_coins_compared: how many coins a per-arm comparison covered
the_allowlist_of_structural_counters.n_days_complete: the day count a receipt states, copied not derived
the_allowlist_of_structural_counters.n_judged_against: how many sealed names the receipt is judged against
the_allowlist_of_structural_counters.n_leaves_emitted: the size of THIS record's own leaf walk
the_allowlist_of_structural_counters.n_low_precision_coincidences: this census's own count of coincidences
the_allowlist_of_structural_counters.n_receipt_keys_walked: the size of the receipt's own KEY walk
the_allowlist_of_structural_counters.n_receipt_leaves_walked: the size of the receipt's own leaf walk
the_allowlist_of_structural_counters.versions_present: the declaration VERSION NUMBERS present on disk -- a version is not a quantity of any day

the_reporting_property.rule: PATHS ONLY. The census reports the PATH in THIS record where a collision sits and NEVER which sealed field matched, and never the value.
the_reporting_property.why: naming the sealed field would publish the association the seal exists to withhold -- 'the field that equals my leaf count' is a fact about the sealed field. A path in my own record is a fact about my record.

float.why: a sealed moment is a long float; a 1-3 digit coincidence identifies nothing, and treating it as evidence made this census refuse its own honest output

integer.rule: AN EXACT EQUALITY REFUSES AT ANY DIGIT COUNT
integer.unless: the emitting PATH is on the allowlist below -- a small, named set of THIS RECORD'S OWN structural counters, each with its reason
integer.why: since R-659 the sealed list carries OUTCOME COUNTS. A digit threshold on integers would let a sealed count ride out under any path that happened to carry it; the path is what separates a counter of mine from a quantity of DE's

what: The numbers the anti-echo census judges by. They were module constants, which means a reader had to read DA's source to know what 'echo' meant -- and a threshold that lives in the checker is a threshold nobody else can argue with.
